There is no separate public/cities/chennai/finance/ sub-page; zone_finance.geojson is the only public finance surface.

sources.label: OpenCity — Chennai Civic Amenities (org: Greater Chennai Corporation)
sources.notes: URL shown is the Chennai Libraries resource (161 records); dataset also supplied burial-grounds, night-shelters and ward-wise public-toilets CSVs (local only, no public layer yet — the night-shelter CSV at source/corporation/facilities/chennai_night_shelters.csv is the mappable register flagged in TODO). Backs libraries.geojson — the public layer carries sl_no/authority/geocode_* properties (149 geocoded facilities via data/cities/chennai/geocode_libraries.py), i.e. it is this GCC facility register, not OSM. Collection landing: https://data.opencity.in/dataset?organization=greater-chennai-corporation.

sources.label: OpenCity — Chennai Schools (aided / high / higher-secondary CSVs)
sources.notes: Local CSVs only (chennai_schools_aided/high/hr_sec.csv). Backs NO public layer — public schools.geojson is the OSM layer (630 features, osm_id properties).

sources.label: OpenCity — Chennai Health Centres, UPHCs and UCHCs (updated 2025-11-27)
sources.notes: Local CSVs only (159 UPHCs, 18 UCHCs). Backs NO public layer — public health.geojson is the OSM hospitals layer (835 features, osm_id properties).

sources.label: Greater Chennai Corporation — official council pages and councillor directory
sources.notes: Scraped 2026-06-09 into source/corporation/councillors.csv (200 ward rows; 194 named, 4 vacant, 2 unlisted; party field deliberately blank — the official directory omits party). Backs the councillors/councillor_phones popups on wards.geojson and the council-status fields of data/cities/chennai/layers/governance.json (elected council since Feb 2022; Mayor R. Priya). Companion about-council page: https://chennaicorporation.gov.in/gcc/council/about-council/. Corroboration recorded on disk: Wikipedia (2022 TN local elections; Priya Rajan) and Citizen Matters.

sources.label: GCC budget books 2019-20 to 2026-27 (OpenCity per-year mirrors of official GCC PDFs)
sources.notes: Official landing pages (chennaicorporation.gov.in/gcc/Budget_YYYY-YYYY/) 404 to programmatic fetch, so OpenCity mirrors are the working source; 2024-25 resolved to 14 direct PDFs in budget_index.json. Backs NO public layer — the Chennai finance page was not built; only zone_finance.geojson (separate 2012-16 dataset) is public.

sources.label: USGS Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 (Landsat 8/9) via Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC API
sources.notes: Land-surface-temperature median derivation: STAC search on collections=['landsat-c2-l2'], platform landsat-8/9, QA-masked, converted by sevent4/domain/heat.py. Backs ward_heat.geojson, ward_heat_summary.json (window 2024-04-01/2026-07-01, n=200 wards), heat30m.png and heat30m_bounds.json. Refresh automated in .github/workflows/heat-refresh.yml.
